desc: A chunky figurine shaped for 3D printing. The one downstream use this path serves almost directly.
source_prompt: a single chunky stylised animal figurine standing on a round flat base, thick legs, limbs tucked close to the body, rounded solid forms, no thin protrusions, the whole figurine inside the frame with margin on all sides, three-quarter view, flat mid-grey seamless background, even frontal light, no cast shadow, no other objects
output: untextured GLB mesh, POSITION attribute only, ~525k tris, ~8.5 MB, 19.5 s
not_usable_for: direct game import. No colour, so no multi-material or AMS printing - it prints in one filament.
note: Printing is the one use where the missing attributes cost nothing: a slicer wants closed geometry and ignores UVs, normals and colour entirely, and 525k triangles is untroubling for a slicer. Surface net extracts a closed iso-surface so the result is usually watertight, which is the property printing actually needs. Verify manifold in the slicer anyway - usually is not always. Nothing here hollows the model, adds supports, or sets a scale; the GLB carries no units.
